usage: 洗頭水 is a noun used to refer to shampoo, the liquid soap for cleaning hair.
You can say '我買咗新嘅洗頭水' to mean 'I bought new shampoo.'
When asking about shampoo, you can use '邊隻洗頭水好用？' meaning 'Which shampoo is good to use?'
洗頭水 usually comes before verbs like 洗 (wash) in a sentence, e.g. '用洗頭水洗頭' means 'wash hair with shampoo.'
You can describe types of shampoo by adding adjectives before 洗頭水, like '天然洗頭水' (natural shampoo).
